question: Which of the following is a hardware input device in a computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scanners**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Scanners:**

 
 
• An input device that captures images or text from a physical source and converts them into digital data that a computer can understand.
 
• **Types of Scanners:**
 
• Flatbed Scanners: Scan documents, photos, and other flat objects.
 
• Sheetfed Scanners: Designed for scanning multiple sheets of paper automatically.
 
• Handheld Scanners: Small and portable, used to scan small items or parts of larger documents.
 
• Uses:
 
• Image Capture: Scanning photos, documents, and artwork.
 
• Data Entry: Digitizing printed text, barcodes, and other data.
 
• Image Editing: Creating digital images for editing and manipulation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **VDU (Visual Display Unit):**

 
 
• An older term for a computer display device, typically referring to a monitor.
 
• Function: Displays visual output from the computer, such as text, images, and videos.
 
• Types VDU (Visual Display Unit):
 
• CRT Monitors: Older technology using cathode ray tubes.
 
• LCD Monitors: More modern and energy-efficient, using liquid crystal displays.
 
• LED Monitors: Utilize light-emitting diodes for backlighting, offering improved color accuracy and energy efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Plotters:**
 
 
• A specialized output device used to create high-quality vector graphics on paper.
 
• Function: Primarily used for producing architectural drawings, engineering blueprints, and other technical illustrations.
 
• Types of Plotters:
 
• Pen Plotters: Use pens to draw lines on paper.
 
• Electrostatic Plotters: Use electrical charges to create images on specially coated paper.
 
 
 
• **Speech Synthesizer:**
 
 
• A technology that converts text into spoken language.
 
• Accessibility: Enables people with visual impairments to access information.
 
• Communication: Used in various applications like voice assistants, navigation systems, and educational software.
 
• Entertainment: Employed in video games, audiobooks, and interactive storytelling.
 
• Text-to-Speech (TTS): Uses algorithms to convert text into a sequence of sounds.
 
• Concatenative Synthesis: Joins together pre-recorded speech units to form words and sentences.
